name: Butchery of the Apex Titan: Munitorum Harvest & Carapace Salvage

cycle_advancement.world_state: Sump Trench Harvested — Carcass Rendering Active

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The 20-ton bio-titan is surrounded by salvage torches and chain-hoists. Enginseer Kroll's servitors strip adamantine chitin plates while corpse-grinders harvest organic tallow and concentrated adrenaline sacs.

completed_milestones.title: Munitorum Harvest of the Sump Bio-Titan Carcass
completed_milestones.consequence: Harvested 24 adamantine chitin plates, rendered 450 ration blocks of protein-tallow, synthesized 12 combat med-stims from adrenal glands, extracted 6 flasks of bioluminescent promethium-tallow, and salvaged swallowed Munitorum munitions.

sub_units.station: Charnel Trench rim (butchering and hauling heavy meat-blocks)
Charnel Trench floor (operating heavy bone-saws and hydraulic cranes)

active_resource_stockpile.quarantine_logistics_alert: HARVEST COMPLETE: Stockpiles replenished across all sectors. 24 armor plates and 450 ration blocks secured.

new_decision.decision: Mobilized Enginseer Kroll's industrial servitors and the 4th Conscripts to systematically butcher the 20-ton bio-titan: harvested 24 adamantine chitin plates, 450 ration blocks of protein-tallow, and synthesized 12 combat med-stims.
new_decision.impact: Replenished critical garrison reserves, fortified logistical security for 3.8 days, and recovered unspent munitions from swallowed underhive victims.

new_decision.decision: Helped the servitors haul massive 500-pound chitin slabs with his power fist, grinning proudly as he was awarded a roasted ten-pound marrow bone by the cooks.
new_decision.impact: Vitality recovered to 60 as heavy protein and field medicae rest heal torn muscle tissues.

new_decision.decision: Pried open the gullet of the beast with gaff-hooks, discovering the intact equipment lockers and web gear of a swallowed Munitorum forward patrol.
new_decision.impact: Recovered 30 lasgun battery packs, 4 heavy stubber belts, and 2 autocannon boxes for the armory.
